lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is generally uniform with a localized decrease in interval distance between the 10th and 12th lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Ventral bifurcation observed on the 4th line from the cranial aspect, forming a subtle Y-shaped split toward the lower torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 5, 7, 8, and 11 exhibit mid-torso termination; line 11 is characterized as a truncated segment confined to the upper dorsal half of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of approximately 6 white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, concentrated in the region superior to the stifle.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A triad of spots forms a semi-horizontal linear alignment across the mid-thigh region.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-contrast white spot on the sub-ocular cheek; prominent white transverse bands observed on the anterior carpal region of the forelimbs; distinct white patch on the ventral neck/throat area.
